description: Trigger a Power BI / Fabric semantic model (dataset) refresh via the Power BI REST API and wait for it to finish. Supports basic (notify_option) and enhanced (selective table/partition, parallelism, incremental-refresh effectiveDate override) refresh.

workspace_id.label: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: Power BI / Fabric workspace ID (GUID) -- the 'groupId' path segment.

dataset_id.label: Dataset Id
dataset_id.description: Power BI / Fabric semantic model (dataset) ID (GUID).

tenant_id_env_var.label: Tenant Id Env Var
tenant_id_env_var.description: Env var with the Azure AD tenant ID (service principal auth). Falls back to DefaultAzureCredential when unset.

client_id_env_var.label: Client Id Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var with the Azure AD app (client) ID.

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var with the Azure AD app client secret.

notify_option.label: Notify Option
notify_option.description: Mail notification option for a BASIC (non-enhanced) refresh. Mutually exclusive with every enhanced-refresh field below -- Power BI's own documented rule requires notifyOption be excluded from an enhanced-refresh request entirely. Not applicable to service-principal auth anyway (Power BI ignores it then); set it only for delegated/user auth.

refresh_type.label: Refresh Type
refresh_type.description: Enhanced refresh only. The type of processing to perform (Power BI's DatasetRefreshType).

commit_mode.label: Commit Mode
commit_mode.description: Enhanced refresh only. 'transactional' commits the whole refresh as one transaction; 'partialBatch' commits in batches (no transaction -- a failure can leave a partial/empty table).

max_parallelism.label: Max Parallelism
max_parallelism.description: Enhanced refresh only. Max threads for parallel processing commands.

retry_count.label: Retry Count
retry_count.description: Enhanced refresh only. Retries before failing (Power BI may still retry transient internal errors even at 0).

objects.label: Objects
objects.description: Enhanced refresh only. Selective refresh targets: list of {table, partition?} dicts. Omit to refresh the whole model.

apply_refresh_policy.label: Apply Refresh Policy
apply_refresh_policy.description: Enhanced refresh only. Whether an incremental refresh policy is applied.

effective_date.label: Effective Date
effective_date.description: Enhanced refresh only. ISO date-time overriding 'today' for an incremental refresh policy's effectiveDate.

request_timeout.label: Request Timeout
request_timeout.description: Enhanced refresh only. Per-attempt timeout as 'HH:MM:SS' (Power BI's own `timeout` field -- caps each refresh ATTEMPT, distinct from this component's own max_wait_seconds, which caps the whole Dagster-side wait across retries).

wait_for_completion.label: Wait For Completion
wait_for_completion.description: If false, trigger the refresh and return without polling for completion.

max_wait_seconds.label: Max Wait Seconds
max_wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the refresh to finish before raising a timeout error (Dagster-side; distinct from request_timeout).

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Log what would be triggered and skip opening a connection entirely -- no token is acquired, no REST call is made.

run_window.label: Run Window
run_window.description: 'HH:MM-HH:MM tz [day,day,...]' (e.g. '22:00-05:00 Europe/Berlin mon,tue,wed,thu,fri'). Outside this window, the asset SKIPS cleanly instead of triggering -- no refresh is started, and real downstream dependents skip too. A malformed spec fails open (never blocks). Unset (default): always runs.

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool -- a cap on concurrent refreshes sharing the same pool name.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream Dagster asset keys for lineage.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners -- team names ('team:analytics') or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the catalog. Auto-includes 'powerbi' if empty.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.
